content.comment_body: After adjusting the time on the clock for testing, my [product_name] ([article_no]) no longer boots. It powers on momentarily, then immediately shuts off and repeats this cycle (basically it keeps blinking). I can't revert the time because the device doesn't stay powered long enough to do anything. This seems like a simple issue, but I'm unable to find any solution. Does anyone have advice?

I haven't encountered or read about this specific error before. Can you connect to the [product_name] using the programming software? If possible, try to perform a factory reset via the tools menu: Tools > Transfer > Factory Reset [product_name].

Hello, I faced a similar problem previously, which was caused by a loosely connected power wire. Please verify that your power supply cables are firmly attached and that the power source is stable and within the required range. Another suggestion: disconnect all [product_name] expansion modules from the base module. If this resolves the issue, review the startup time settings on the base module and consider configuring a longer duration. You can adjust the startup time between 1 and 10 seconds to give the base module enough time to recognize connected expansion modules. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users indicate that after changing the clock time on the [product_name] base module, the device starts to restart repeatedly and becomes unusable, making it impossible to revert settings. The problem may be linked to either power supply issues or misconfiguration, and users express frustration over the lack of clear instructions and documentation to address the situation. The absence of straightforward troubleshooting steps hinders recovery and increases user dissatisfaction.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the device to recover reliably from configuration changes and remain accessible for further adjustments. They also anticipate easily accessible and clear troubleshooting guidance to restore the system. Consistent and dependable operation is expected even after making configuration changes.
